name: The Drowned Scriptorium of the Reef-Giants
flavor: Delve into turquoise-flooded giant-vaults to recover a lost brass star-chart before the saboteurs complete their plot.

phases.narration: You leave the timber docks of Azure behind, sailing through the broken outer sea-wall into the sun-dappled shallows. Ahead, the shattered pediment of the Reef-Giant Scriptorium juts from the turquoise water, its emerald marble stairs submerged beneath gently swaying kelp. As your skiff glides into the flooded antechamber, scuttling scavengers and coral-scaled sentries rise from the sunken flagstones to bar your passage.

Wading deeper through waist-high sea water, you enter the towering scriptorium halls. Shelves carved for giants stretch into the vaulted shadows, filled with stone tablets and tarnished brass scroll-cases. Clockwork sentinels left behind by the ancient builders grind to life in the flooded aisles, their brass joints groaning as they ready heavy clamps and disruption cantrips to halt your advance.

You step into the central rotunda of the Scriptorium. At the room's center, resting upon a submerged dais, glitters the colossal brass star-chart Princess Turanda seeks. But standing over it is Archon Pelagios—a titanic giant-automaton whose core burns with sapphire sea-fire. As you breach the chamber, its ocular lenses ignite with golden light, and its massive bronze limbs churn the flooded floor into a roaring whirlpool.
